letters.title: Three Years
letters.text: Theres so much we still haven't done. I can't wait to do it all with you.

letters.title: First Date
letters.text: I still remember feeling so nervous on our first date. I didn't know what to say.

letters.title: Your So Cute
letters.text: You seriously are.

letters.title: Intruder
letters.text: I used to sneak into your room, sometimes through the window. We got caught on occasion.

letters.title: Warm
letters.text: Sleeping has never been easier than when I'm next to you.

letters.title: Partners
letters.text: We make a great team, I'd always choose you.

letters.title: Laufey
letters.text: Two of my favourite nights spent with you.

letters.title: Take Me Out
letters.text: I felt so connected to you that night in Apollo Bay, when we watched the band from afar.

letters.title: Thank You
letters.text: Thank you for being patient with me, for believing in me, and for making every day easier.

letters.title: Pink
letters.text: Pink, blonde, blue, red, whatever colour comes next, you're beautiful in all of them.

letters.title: Pretty
letters.text: Pretty eyes, pretty smile, such a pretty girl.

letters.title: Fiery
letters.text: You may be fiery, but you spice up my life.

letters.title: Everything
letters.text: You are my everything and all of it. I love you Suzy my beautiful girl.

letters.title: Proud
letters.text: I'm so proud of you. Of everything you've done and are going to do.

letters.title: Bad Days
letters.text: On your bad days, I'll be here. On your good days, I'll be here too, cheering the loudest.

letters.title: Time
letters.text: There is no better way to spend my time than with you.

letters.title: Nervous
letters.text: I still remember you saying 'your so far away', and my heart racing.

letters.title: A Promise
letters.text: I promise to be there when you need me. Every time.

letters.title: Our future
letters.text: I can't wait for all the places we haven't been yet, and all the memories we haven't made.

letters.title: I love you
letters.text: I love you Suzy. Happy anniversary.
